name: Representation Theory of Finite Groups
description:
Revision of basic group theory. Definition and examples of representation. Sub-representation, sum and tensor product of representations, irreducible representations; Character Theory: Character of a representation, Schur’s Lemma, Maschke’s theorem, Orthogonality relations for characters, decomposition of regular representation, number of irreducible representations of a group; 
Representation of subgroups and product of groups, induced representations; Group Algebra: Representations and C[G]-modules; Decomposition of complex algebra C[G], Integrability properties of characters, Burnside’s pq theorem. Induced representations, restriction to subgroups, Reciprocity formula, Mackey’s irreducibility criterion; Irreducible representations of symmertric groups (S_n) and alternating groups (A_n).
